osānagāthādvaya: [osānagāthā + dvaya] (na) CL=7 A group of two verses that are the last.
osānakalāpa: [osāna + kalāpa] (pu) CL=7 (A bundle of bamboos) that is the end.
osānakaraṇattha: [osānakaraṇa + attha] (ti) CL=7 The meaning of showing the end.
osānakiriyā: [osāna + kiriyā] (thī, na) CL=7 Showing the end.
osānakkhaṇa: [osāna + khaṇa] (pu) CL=7 The moment of ceasing or conclusion.

osānakāla: [osāna + kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of last time.

osānapada: [osāna + pada] (na) CL=7 The last word or conclusion word.

osānasukha: [osāna + sukha] (na) CL=7 The last pleasure or happiness.

osānavayāpekkha: [osānavaya + apekkhā] (ti) CL=7 Looking for the last lifespan.
osānavigata: [osāna + vigata] (ti) CL=7 Free from the end (the boundary). Not reach to the end. Endless.
osāpana: [ata + sā(so) + ṇāpe + yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Causes to complete. (2) Puts into.

osārayissāmi: [ava + sara + ṇaya + ssāmi] (kri) CL=7 (I) will carry out.

(2) the announcement- act- the monastic disciplinary procedure. (3) Moving down. (the lotus that moves down- descends. Vajīra. Sya.)
[u(ava) + sara + yu] (thī, na) CL=7 (1) Chanting pāḷi repeatedly to memorize.

osāraṇakāla: [osāraṇa + kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of reciting.
osāraṇapaccaya: [osāraṇa + paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause of re-entering.

osārema: [ava + sara + ṇe + ma] (kā, kri) CL=7 We take out (to outside). See - Osāreti 1 (3).
osārenta: [ava + sara + ṇe + anta.]  CL=9 [In the feminine gender, there is osārentī.] (1) One who causes sb to enter (among Saṃgha) one who brings sb (into the Saṃgha). (2) one who pulls down. (Pakhukkū, sya.) (3) one who causes to move.
[u(ava) + sara + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who recites (pāḷi).
osārenti: [ava + sara + ṇe + anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) They cause to enter the buddhist monastic order. They reinstate. See - Osāreti 1 (1).
osāresi: [u(ava) + sara + ṇe + si] (kā, kri) CL=7 You recite (pāḷi). See - Osāreti2.

osāressāmi: [ava + sara + ṇe + ssāmi] (kā, kri) CL=7 I will cause to enter (the buddhist monastic order). I will reinstate. See - Osāreti 1 (1).

osāresuṃ: [ava + sara + ṇe + uṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They caused to enter (the buddhist monastic order). They reinstated. See - Osāreti1 (1).
osāretabba: [ava + sara + ṇe + tabba] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who should be admitted to the Buddhist monastic order. (2) Should be believed by wisdom.
[u + sara + ṇe + tabba. ] (ti) CL=7 [Ava + sara + ṇe + tabba.] Should be recited.
osāretha: [ava + sara + ṇe + etha] (kā, kri) CL=7 May you (pl) admit to entering (the buddhist monastic order). May you (pl)  reinstate. See - Osāreti 1 (1).
[u(ava) + sara + ṇe + tha] (kā, kri) CL=7 May you (pl) recite (pāḷi). See - Osāreti 2.

[u(ava) + sara + ṇe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 He teaches or preaches (pāḷi).
osāretuṃ: [ava + sara + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To put into or to reinstate.
[u(ava) + sara + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To recite (pāḷi).
osāretvā: [ava + sara + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (1) Having admitted to enter the buddhist monastic order. (2) Having thrown down or having immersed. (3) Having caused to come down. Having placed down. Having hung down. Having clung down.
[u(ava) + sara + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) Having recited. (B) Having recited (pāḷi).

[ava + sara + ṇe + eyyaṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) He should cause to enter (the Buddhist monastic order). He reinstates. See - Osāreti 1 (1).
osāreyyaṃ: [ava + sara + ṇe + eyyaṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) He should cause to enter (the Buddhist monastic order). He reinstates. See - Osāreti 1 (1).
osārita: [ava + sara + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be reinstated. (2) Should be immersed. (3) Should be hung down.

osārituṃ: [ava + sara + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cause to enter or to reinstate.

osīdati: [ava + sīda + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) He sinks down. (2) He draws back or is sluggish. (3) He moves down or slides down.
osīdenta: [ava + sīda + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to sink down.

osīdāpana: [ava + sīda + ṇāpe + yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Causes to immerse. (Ti) (2) Caused to sink down.
osīdāpanaṭṭha: [osīdāpana + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of that causes to sink down.
osīdāpenti: [ava + sīda + ṇāpe + anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They cause to immerse. See - Osīdāpeti.
osīdāpesi: [ava + sīda + ṇāpe + ī] (kā, kri) CL=7 You caused to sink down. See - Osīdāpeti.

osīdāpeti: [ata + sīda + ṇāpe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 He causes to immerse.
osīdāpetvā: [ava + sīda + ṇāpe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (1) Having caused to sink down. (2) Having put (in).
